author: Honours
body:
Well Rilo beat me to it so here is another chance for people who don't win his giveaway.
Also I wanted to do something special as a farewell present to avicus. I'm not really known around avicus mostly because I'm not good enough to be known and I also never posted in the forums and what not. but Playing here has a been a blast and I will miss avicus alot but due to personal reasons I have to take a long well deserved break from avicus and MC in general. 

Anyways back to what people care about If you want to be entered in the giveaway.

1. Drop a sub https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCig18T9nUKzrlOMEdHj7LjQ ( you really don't have too)
2. Just comment below "done" 

Winners will be picked Aprill 21st!!! 

Farewell Avicus <3
